result.summary: Several layout and clipping problems: category chips and restaurant cards overflow the screen, one restaurant name is truncated, and a promo card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is clipped by the right edge of the screen, so the row looks broken and extra categories are not clearly discoverable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with peek/fade or wrap chips so all labels remain fully visible.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off on the right and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths with horizontal paging/scroll, or shrink cards so three full cards fit without clipping names.

issues.description: The second Popular restaurant card is only partially visible at the bottom of the viewport, so the listing looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Give the list more vertical space above the tab bar or ensure cards fully snap into view while scrolling.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles or use a shorter display name so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The profile/notification control in the top-right is a nearly empty circle with a tiny red badge, which looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear icon or avatar inside the circle so the control is recognizable.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icons sit on dark food photos with limited contrast, which may make them hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Increase icon contrast (stronger background pill or outline) so favorites remain visible.
